result.audit_criteria: WebTrust Principles and Criteria for Certification Authorities – TLS Baseline v2.9

disclosed_matters.summary: One subscriber TLS certificate included an emailAddress attribute in the Distinguished Name that was not permitted in the CP/CPS-approved subscriber certificate profile; the certificate was revoked the same day the issue was detected.
A valid OV SSL test certificate website temporarily served an expired certificate due to an outdated DR DNS record pointing to an old host; the DNS records were corrected on the same day.
